Stratify Patients into Risk Groups from Training and Test MAEs

Source: R/visualizations.R
patient_stratification.Rd

Single entry point that (1) extracts a model's per-patient risk scores from the training MultiAssayExperiment, (2) derives a cut-point on those training scores, and (3) extracts and stratifies the test predictions using that cut-point. Survival outcome (overall_survival and status) is read directly from colData(mae); extraction and coercion are handled internally. Predictions are read from metadata(mae)$analysis[[model]][[modality]][[split]]$pred.

Usage

patient_stratification(
  mae_train,
  mae_test = NULL,
  model,
  modality = NULL,
  container = NULL,
  rho = NULL,
  method = c("median", "mediana", "user", "survcutpoint"),
  threshold = NULL,
  plot_scores = FALSE,
  minprop = 0.1,
  inclusive = FALSE,
  colors = .risk_colors(),
  time_col = "overall_survival",
  status_col = "status"
)

Arguments

mae_train

A MultiAssayExperiment holding the training split; the threshold and the optional score histogram are derived from it. colData must contain "overall_survival" and "status".

mae_test

A MultiAssayExperiment holding the test split, to be stratified with the training threshold. If NULL, the threshold is applied back to the training set.

model

Character string naming the model in metadata()$analysis (e.g. "cox_elastic_net").

modality

Character string naming the omics modality (e.g. an "early_<omics>" tag, "mRNA", "meth"). Leave NULL for models stored without a modality level (joint methods such as "blockForest", and "flexynesis"), or to auto-resolve a model that has a single per-modality entry (e.g. one early-integration tag, or the single ensemble under container = "late_integration").

container

Optional container to disambiguate models whose names are reused across integration strategies. Use "late_integration" to read the consensus prediction of a late-integration ensemble (e.g. model = "cox_lasso", container = "late_integration"); the sample IDs are taken from its merged_risks table.

rho

Numeric. For model = "AFTCoop" only: selects the beta_rho_<rho> variant (e.g. rho = 0.5). If NULL (default) and only one rho was trained, it is resolved automatically; if multiple rho values are present, an error lists the available keys.

method

Threshold method:

  • "median" (alias "mediana"): median of the training scores.

  • "user": user-supplied value, passed via threshold.

  • "survcutpoint": optimal cut-point via surv_cutpoint.

threshold

Numeric cut-point. Required when method = "user".

plot_scores

Logical. If TRUE, draws and returns a histogram of the training scores coloured by risk group, with the threshold marked. Default is FALSE.

minprop

Minimum group proportion for surv_cutpoint. Default is 0.1.

inclusive

Logical. If TRUE, scores equal to the threshold are assigned to "High risk". Default is FALSE.

colors

Named character vector mapping "High risk" and "Low risk" to colours. Default is c("High risk" = "red", "Low risk" = "deepskyblue").

time_col, status_col

Names of the survival time and event columns in colData. Default to "overall_survival" and "status".

Value

A list with:

  • strata: the stratified test data.frame (pass to plot_km / plot_umap).

  • threshold: the numeric cut-point used.

  • method: the threshold method applied.

  • train: the stratified training data.frame.

  • histogram: a ggplot object, or NULL.

See also

plot_km, plot_umap
